items.title: Dollar Tree Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates as Traffic Gains Lift Sales
items.summary: DLTR beats Q3 earnings and revenue estimates as rising customer traffic fuels comparable sales growth, while tariff-refund reinvestments pressure margins.

items.title: Retail stocks surge into Black Friday amid earnings beats
items.summary: Investing.com - U.S. retail stocks are rallying broadly Tuesday as a rotation out of AI and technology names accelerates into the holiday season, with Kohl’s Corp (NYSE:KSS) leading the group with a 14.2% surge after its most recent quarter beat consensus by $1.76 per share. The State Street® SPDR® S&P® Retail ETF (NYSE:XRT) is gaining 1.84% alongside its largest constituents as money flows out of technology and into consumer-facing value plays with Black Friday three days away.

items.title: Oakridge Mall Deal Might Change The Case For Investing In Macerich (MAC)
items.summary: Macerich acquired the 1.1 million square foot Oakridge Mall in San Jose in 2026 for about US$250 million, adding a high traffic, high sales productivity center with roughly 10.8 million annual visits and anchors including Target, Macy’s, 99 Ranch Market, Nordstrom Rack and Century Theatres. Oakridge Mall’s approximately US$866 inline sales per square foot, a wealthy 1.7 million resident trade area and unencumbered status give Macerich a large, already productive asset with leasing momentum...

items.title: Consumer Mood Improves Into Holidays, But Risks Loom
items.summary:
US consumer confidence surged in November to the highest in nearly two years as Americans grew more optimistic about the economy and the job market. 
Seema Shah, VP: Insights at Sensor Tower, discusses consumer trends and spending ahead of Black Friday and the holidays.
